issues.title: Experimental beer comparison can be confusing
issues.description: The experimental comparison may present values that are easy to interpret as day counts or strong conclusions when the sample is small.
issues.workaround: Treat CHB Intelligence as experimental and verify the sample-size labels.
issues.plannedResolution: Dedicated CHB Intelligence quality pass with clearer units, minimum sample sizes and confidence indicators.

issues.title: Production main chunk exceeds the Vite warning threshold
issues.description: The production bundle currently emits a chunk-size warning after minification.
issues.workaround: The warning does not block deployment.
issues.plannedResolution: Add route-level lazy loading and production code splitting during a later quality pass.
